decision_scope: Documentary preparation only, not promotion or a statistical rejection
UNCERTAINTY: No issuer contract or notice selected. No actual selling, executable price route, quantity, borrow or friction established. Rule applicability is scoped; not all expirations create a required news-service announcement. An issuer notice and EDGAR acceptance can differ from first public availability.
POWER_LIMITATION: No event sample, issuer returns or empirical estimate; source documentation cannot establish an edge.
ECONOMIC_SIGNIFICANCE: Previously restricted holders can demand diversification/liquidity after release, potentially compensating inventory suppliers. Public anticipation, underwriter information/selection and rational adverse-selection risk can explain the same price pattern. No compulsory seller identified.
FAILED_CRITERIA: Universal IPO+180 clock is not valid: contractual terms vary
Permission to sell is not a commitment or requirement to sell
Price access/execution adequacy and an empirical result remain unqualified
LESSON: An explicit public waiver notice can define a narrow observable information event, but must not be relabelled a mandatory sale or a universal expiry calendar.
FAMILY_STATUS: READY_FOR_NON_OUTCOME_DESIGN_ONLY; no economic look or PROMOTE decision

NEXT_DECISION.question: Prepare, without issuer prices or outcomes, the smallest notice-defined prospective L1 for an explicitly dated unconditional officer/director lockup release/waiver. Do not use IPO+180, infer a sale, or treat EDGAR acceptance as first public news. Freeze scope, independent notice/operative clocks, quantity/costs, fixed horizon, adequacy, benchmark and one adversary only if an admissible market-data route and discriminating question can be stated; otherwise PARK_DATA/PARK_ECONOMICS. A-E admission keeps priority. No newly admitted issuer or collector in this preparation task.

prospective_priority.ordering: earliest qualifying EDGAR accepted across A-E, then smaller CIK; original exclusions and protocol-specific ties unchanged

mechanism.who_pays: Potentially concentrated insiders/early investors seeking liquidity or diversification, and liquidity-demanding counterparties; actual selling and realised transfers are unobserved.
mechanism.why_persist: Contractual resale restrictions can bunch optional liquidity demand; capital and adverse-selection constraints may limit absorption. Anticipation can remove any premium.
mechanism.distinctness: Voluntary supply unlocked by contracts differs from mandated index deletion. Both may share an inventory/flow cluster, so no independence claim or multiplicity reset.
mechanism.main_alternative: Endogenous early waivers may coincide with favourable issuer information, secondary offerings or past performance, rather than a mechanical liquidity shock.

primary_facts.version_basis: Legacy SEC educational page as retrieved; no authenticated original-publication time.
facts: Insider lockup restrictions are contractual and can differ in duration and quantity; the article describes180 days as common, not universal.
Registration documents/prospectus disclose applicable terms. A commercial expiry calendar is not endorsed evidence of issuer-specific terms.
The SEC discusses possible anticipatory price pressure, a public qualitative prior rather than a new return observation.

primary_facts.version_basis: Rulebook text retrieved now; response Last-Modified is metadata, not historical effectiveness for every transaction. Current page lists amendments including SR-FINRA-2026-007.
facts: For the officer/director restrictions covered by paragraph(d)(2), the provision specifies notification to the issuer and public announcement at least two business days before a release/waiver, subject to stated exceptions.

Specified no-consideration or immediate-family transfers can be excepted when the transferee accepts the original restriction. Exclude these from any supply expression rather than assuming cash sales.
Supplementary Material.03 allows announcement by lead manager, another member or issuer; qualifying secondary-offering registration disclosure can satisfy the announcement requirement.
limits: Not evidence that all ordinary scheduled expirations or non-officer/director holders have the same announcement rule.
No evidence that released shares will be sold, that the news is surprising or that a stock moves in a profitable direction.

primary_facts.fact: Linked Notice12-24 addresses pre-secondary-trading market-order restrictions under5131(d)(4), not the lockup-clock interpretation sought. Retained as a source mismatch; no fourth request.

design_boundaries: Only a future separately declared notice-defined scope may be prepared; no issuer admitted here.
No issuer+180 automatic calendar, historical winners, reconstructed first-public clock or inferred actual sale.
Do not treat a release conditional on market prices as unconditional; any such price-dependent eligibility would itself require pre-access declaration/claim.
No short/borrow route assumed free. Long inventory or other payoff definition and costs must be fixed before outcomes.
Do not shorten horizons or replace cost/issuer rules after results; existing closed families remain closed.
